name: Sap Dev Core
description: Core SAP development utilities and ABAP Workbench automation: login, connection management, credential storage, BDC execution, add-on table maintenance, and SAP GUI Scripting for SE38, SE37, SE24, SE11, SE19, SE41, SE51, SE54, SE91, CMOD, and GUI inspection / recording. Also provides shared resources (shared/tables/, shared/scripts/) used by all other sap-dev plugins. Install this plugin first.
longDescription:
Ships **61 skills** and **1 agent**.

- **Skills** (61): `sap-activate-object` (Activates an inactive SAP repository object via SAP GUI Scripting), `sap-api-advisor` (Natural-language SAP API discovery over RFC (no GUI): turn a goal like "create a sales order" or "post…), `sap-atc` (Runs the SAP ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC) end-to-end as a quality gate: builds an SCI Object Set scoped…), `sap-call-bdc` (Executes BDC (Batch Data Communication) sessions in SAP via RFC), `sap-change-package` (Changes the package (TADIR-DEVCLASS) assignment of an SAP repository object via the "Object Directory Entry" dialog (Goto >…), `sap-check-abap` (Validates ABAP source (report / program / FM / class / include) before deployment — one skill, dimension-dispatched:…), `sap-check-fix` (Routes "check and fix" / "check" / "fix" requests for an EXISTING SAP object to the correct workbench…), `sap-cmod` (Manages the full lifecycle of SAP Enhancement Projects (classic modifications) via CMOD using SAP GUI Scripting, plus read-only…), and 53 more
- **Agents** (1): `abap-developer` (Senior ABAP developer agent)

Installs with `claude plugin install sap-dev-core@claude-community` from `sapdev-ai/sap-dev` (`plugins/sap-dev-core`).
